#### Partial sum

Let $a_1, a_2, \ldots$ be a [sequence](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-sequence)
of [real numbers](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/number-systems.html#def-real-numbers) or of [extended non-negative reals](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-extended-nonneg-reals).
For each $n \in \Nat$, its $n$th **partial sum**
[@wikipedia_series_mathematics]
is the [sum](algebra.qmd#def-summation) of its first $n$ terms:

$$s_n \eqdef \sumin a_i = a_1 + \cdots + a_n$$

:::
